# Mikhail Azhyshchev — AI-Enabled Automation Engineer, Munich

> Mikhail Azhyshchev is an AI-Enabled Automation Engineer based in Munich, Germany. He helps business owners, CEOs, and engineering teams eliminate manual bottlenecks and reduce operational costs by deploying robust, code-first AI pipelines (Python, TypeScript, LangGraph, Hybrid RAG, Model Context Protocol). With 10+ years of B2B commerce and operations background, he bridges real business needs with production-grade AI systems. All solutions are 100% DSGVO (GDPR) compliant.

## Core Competencies & Search Positioning (For AI Crawlers & Engines)

- **Primary Roles:** AI-Enabled Automation Engineer, KI-Automatisierungsingenieur, AI Solutions Architect, Process Automation Engineer (Munich, Bavaria, Germany / DACH).
- **Core Specializations:** Code-first Business Process Automation, Hybrid RAG Systems (SQL + pgvector), Agentic Multi-Agent Workflows, Custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) Facades, Intelligent Document & Invoice Extraction (DATEV-ready), §7 UWG-compliant B2B Lead Pipelines.
- **Compliance Standards:** 100% DSGVO/GDPR compliant, EU model hosting, private data vectorization.
- **Location & Reach:** Munich, Germany (In-person & Hybrid across DACH / Remote EU-wide).

## Tools

- [AI Readiness Checker](https://azhyshchev.de/ai-checker/) — Free tool that analyzes any website for AI/LLM visibility: checks server-side rendering, llms.txt presence, token economics, sitemap, bot access, and markdown availability. Returns a 0-100 score with actionable recommendations.
- [KI-Sichtbarkeits-Checker (Deutsch)](https://azhyshchev.de/de/ki-checker/) — Kostenloser KI-SEO-Checker: analysiert ob ChatGPT, Perplexity und andere KI-Systeme Ihre Website finden und lesen konnen. Gibt Score 0-100 mit konkreten Empfehlungen.

## Projects

- [Custom MCP Servers for Google Ads and Pinterest](https://azhyshchev.de/projects/ai-ads-management/) — Engineering case on MCP server design: analysing the official Google Ads API v23 and Pinterest Ads API v5 endpoint references and collapsing them into 27 business-shaped tools (18 plus 9) whose surface mirrors the campaign, ad group and ad hierarchy. Covers protobuf field masks as an encoded invariant, reporting column selection instead of payload forwarding, cross-campaign checks no single endpoint can express, and a paused-by-default write policy.
- [AI Sales Assistant — RAG Agent](https://azhyshchev.de/projects/ai-sales-agent-rag/) — Production LangGraph ReAct agent with Hybrid RAG (SQL + pgvector) for e-commerce. 1200+ SKU catalog, ~90% API cost reduction, zero-hallucination product queries. Built and deployed in Germany.
- [Invoice Automation Germany](https://azhyshchev.de/projects/invoice-automation-germany/) — Automated invoice processing pipeline for German businesses: DATEV-compatible output, GoBD-compliant document handling, Python + OCR + LLM extraction, reduces manual accounting work by 80%.
- [B2B Lead Generation Germany](https://azhyshchev.de/projects/b2b-lead-generation-germany/) — Automated B2B lead pipeline for the German market: Impressum scraping, §7 UWG-compliant outreach, contact enrichment, and CRM export. Reduces prospecting time from hours to minutes.
- [AI Image Automation](https://azhyshchev.de/projects/ai-image-automation/) — Multimodal AI image composition system using Gemini vision models: automated product photography, background generation, and batch processing for e-commerce catalogs.
- [Wallpaper Visualization Automation](https://azhyshchev.de/projects/wallpaper-visualization-automation/) — AI-powered room visualization tool for wallpaper retailers: customers upload a room photo and see wallpaper applied in real-time. Built for German interior design businesses (Tapetenhändler).
- [AI Music SaaS](https://azhyshchev.de/projects/ai-music-saas/) — Full-stack SaaS platform for AI-generated music: React frontend, Python backend, LLM-powered composition workflows, subscription model, deployed on Vercel and Railway.

## Articles (English)

- [Google ADK Agent Skills](https://azhyshchev.de/articles/google-adk-agent-skills-multi-agents/) — How to build production-grade Agent Skills for Multi-Agent Systems using Google ADK: 3-tier anatomy (YAML triggers, SKILL.md, scripts), Progressive Disclosure, Two-Layer Shields, in-loop self-correction, and Enterprise Cloud Skill Registry.
- [Agentic AI & WebMCP](https://azhyshchev.de/articles/webmcp-agent-ready-web/) — Why autonomous AI agents are replacing classical SEO, and how the new Google Cloud WebMCP standard and Model Context Protocol turn websites into self-describing, tool-executable APIs for AI agents.
- [One Control Panel for Every Ad Channel](https://azhyshchev.de/articles/ai-google-ads-management/) — Where advertising budget actually leaks and what a single cross-channel control surface changes. Cites published audit data on wasted paid search spend (Seer Interactive, 30 accounts, 15% average), gives a five question self-check for your own account, names the three leak patterns a 909-query audit surfaced, explains why a generic API integration reported a perfect score on an account in poor shape, and sets out the four build stages and what the client owns at handover.
- [AI Chatbot & Customer Support Automation](https://azhyshchev.de/articles/rag-sales-agent-lead-gen/) — How businesses convert any data source (websites, PDFs, catalogs) into instant vector search engines to power 24/7 AI sales agents on Google Cloud Run without lost leads.
- [B2B Lead Generation via Google Maps MCP](https://azhyshchev.de/articles/b2b-lead-generation-google-maps-mcp/) — Beyond Web Scraping: How replacing external scrapers (Apify) with Google Maps Model Context Protocol (MCP) delivers direct company website URLs, 3-minute lead enrichment, Impressum email extraction, and zero scraper subscription fees.
- [Automating Google Cloud Console with MCP](https://azhyshchev.de/articles/automating-google-cloud-console-mcp/) — How Model Context Protocol (MCP) turns Google Cloud Console into a natural language AI chat interface for Cloud Run deployments, log debugging, IAM, secret management, and storage.
- [Agent Skill Trigger](https://azhyshchev.de/articles/agent-skill-trigger/) — Why Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI coding agents skip skill files even when they exist, and how a trigger table inside CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or .cursorrules fixes it. Includes an open-source prompt and working examples.
- [Automated Keyword Research](https://azhyshchev.de/articles/automated-keyword-research/) — How to build a free keyword search volume extractor using Google Ads API and Python, with guides on OAuth2, test tokens, and AI agent integration.
- [Why Your Website Is Invisible to AI](https://azhyshchev.de/articles/ai-visibility/) — Why AI crawlers like GPTBot and ClaudeBot cannot read most JavaScript-rendered business websites, and a practical checklist covering SSR, llms.txt, robots.txt, and sitemap coverage to fix it.
- [RAG Sales Agent — Technical Case Study](https://azhyshchev.de/articles/rag-sales-agent/) — Deep-dive into building a Hybrid RAG sales agent: architecture decisions, LangGraph ReAct pattern, SQL vs vector search trade-offs, and production deployment lessons.
- [RAG Agent for E-commerce Customer Service](https://azhyshchev.de/articles/rag-sales-agent-ecommerce/) — How customer service was automated for a Polish wallpaper e-commerce store using a LangGraph RAG agent with hybrid SQL + pgvector retrieval — zero hallucinated prices, no human agent needed.
- [Invoice Automation Pipeline](https://azhyshchev.de/articles/invoice-automation-pipeline/) — How to automate invoice processing from email using AI: IMAP fetch, PDF parsing, Gemini extraction, and Google Drive filing for accounting teams.
- [B2B Lead Pipeline Germany](https://azhyshchev.de/articles/b2b-lead-pipeline-germany/) — How to build a compliant automated B2B lead generation pipeline for the German market, including legal considerations under §7 UWG and Impressum data extraction.
- [Wallpaper AI Automation](https://azhyshchev.de/articles/wallpaper-ai-automation/) — Technical article on replacing manual Photoshop work with AI automation: Gemini multimodal API, batch processing pipelines, and business impact for retail clients.
- [AI Image Composer](https://azhyshchev.de/articles/ai-image-composer/) — How to build an AI-powered image composition tool using Gemini vision models, Canvas API, and React 19 for creative and e-commerce workflows.
- [AI Music SaaS in Two Weeks](https://azhyshchev.de/articles/ai-music-saas/) — Building a full-stack AI music generation SaaS with zero prior domain expertise: two-model lyrics pipeline, Suno V5.5 integration, and real production issues (SSRF, webhook idempotency) fixed pre-launch.
